facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance (Vote 020) policy statement budgets its Programme 11 Digital Transformation at UGX 96.580 billion recurrent plus UGX 46.426 billion development (GoU-funded, external financing zero) for FY2026/27, UGX 143.006 billion in all.
facts.system: Programme 11 Digital Transformation, Vote 020 Ministry of ICT and National Guidance, FY2026/27

facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance vote total (GoU, excluding arrears) is UGX 144.696 billion for FY2026/27 against an approved UGX 105.963 billion for FY2025/26, which is higher; both figures are the ministry's own and external financing is zero in both years.
facts.system: Vote 020 Ministry of ICT and National Guidance budget, FY2025/26 to FY2026/27

note: Document gives budget estimates and approved figures only; spending to end December 2025 (UGX 40.566 billion) is a half-year figure for FY2025/26, not a full-year spent amount, so no spent fact. Date is the FY2026/27 budget cycle year since the statement carries no exact day (published 2026-01-01 is a proxy).
